entries.title: Answers you start on a card follow you to your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: Picks, the words in a card's field and notes you add on your iPhone or iPad now show in your computers' windows a moment later, and theirs show on your phone. A pick made while your computer is out of reach goes once it is back, unless you changed the same question somewhere else meanwhile. Nothing is sent until you press a button or send a reply.
entries.noPicture: The card looks the same on the phone; what changes is that a pick made on one screen appears on the others.
